topic: Day 102 — reel — The moment change feels impossible is usually right before it happens
text:
The resistance
spikes right
before it [breaks].
caption:
The old pattern fights hardest when it's about to lose. That last stretch of impossible is usually the final part, not a signal to stop.

Follow for one of these a day.
